name: Equipment volume purchase agreement
description: Multi-year (up to five years at ASML) framework agreement between a tool maker and a chipmaker that sets discounts, credits and free goods; individual tool orders, often with down payments and slot reservations, are drawn against it.

name: Volume-based manufacturing-software fee (Gainshare)
description: Fab-software fee that scales with the customer's wafer manufacturing volumes or data transferred (PDF Solutions Gainshare, secureWISE data, Cimetrix runtime licences), alongside fixed licences and SaaS.
